function.name: system-tests
function.description: Executes the project's test command. `parameters` is an array of argv words for go test (e.g. ["./agent"] or ["-run", "TestStoredToolRow"]); pass ["./..."] to run the suite as configured.

parameters.description: Arguments for go test, one word per element (e.g. ["./agent"] or ["-run", "TestX", "./data"]). An empty array will not run any tests - pass ["./..."] to run all tests.
